deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications are due January 8, 2027; the physics timeline also asks for fees paid or waived by then.
deadline.quote: Application Timeline – Fall 2027 | by January 8 | All applications must be submitted and application fees paid or waived

gre_general.value: The department is GRE-optional for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: We are GRE-optional and require Zoom interviews for PhD applications

gre_subject.value: The Physics subject GRE is optional and may help an application.
gre_subject.quote: The subject GRE is optional but may strengthen your application

app_fee.value: Physics applicants pay the $80 application fee unless they qualify for a waiver.
app_fee.quote: pay the application fee of $80, unless you are eligible for a waiver

fee_waiver.value: The department says international students are not eligible for fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: International students are not eligible for fee waivers

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department's Graduate Committee after interviews, not by a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: The decision to admit a student is made by the Graduate Committee of the Physics Department

funding.value: Full-time PhD students get a full tuition waiver and a yearly stipend (2026-27: $31,236) as a teaching or research assistant.
funding.quote: full-time PhD students receive a full tuition waiver and a yearly stipend of $31,236

entry_route.value: The physics pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed before the PhD.

notes: Reynolda Campus Ph.D. in Physics. Medical Physics (PhD, MS, certificate) is a separate CAMPEP program on the Bowman Gray Campus, not saved here. The physics page says applicants must follow the Medical Physics program's own admissions page.
